city natives.bio: East Coast Canadian hip-hop group City Natives brings Indigenous perspectives into a hard-edged rap catalogue built by members Shelby Sappier, Brandon Arnold and Blake Francis.

cri.bio: Québec producer Christophe Dubé, known as CRi, makes melodic electronic music that blends house, future-facing bass production and dreamy pop textures.

d.o. gibson.bio: Canadian rapper, author and motivational speaker D.O. Gibson, born Duane Gibson, pairs hip-hop with youth outreach and is known for once holding a Guinness World Record for longest freestyle rap.

dijahsb.bio: Toronto rapper DijahSB pairs warm, agile flows with candid writing about identity, work, mental health and perseverance over jazz-rooted and electronic hip-hop production.

dillanponders.bio: Toronto rapper DillanPonders is a prolific independent artist whose versatile hip-hop moves between trap, introspection and high-energy performance.
